advisory.disposition: weekly-default-branch/manual exact-main security analysis (no PR/push CodeQL)
advisory.reason: CodeQL analysis is deliberately not triggered on PRs or main pushes. Full Actions and Java/Kotlin CodeQL runs on the Wednesday scheduled protected-main baseline and explicit exact-current-main manual dispatch, both advisory and outside the required Merge Gate. Newly merged vulnerabilities may remain undetected until the next successful weekly/manual run; delayed, cancelled or failed schedules can extend that interval. New repository-managed automated Marketplace publication is blocked unless eligible exact-tag/current-main CodeQL run identity and original SARIF High/Critical verdict pass; public GitHub Release creation and out-of-band manual uploads remain owner-controlled and outside that workflow's protection. Required Merge Gate still independently aggregates Build/Test/Plugin Verifier/workflow-policy/dependency evidence.
